content: Hey, hope your day wasn't too stressful. I've been thinking about our talk last night, it honestly made me smile all morning.
Aw, that's sweet. I was actually looking forward to our chat tonight, too. Work's been draining, but this helps.
You really lift my spirits. I wish I could be there to cook you dinner and unwind with you after those tough meetings.
That sounds perfect... Sometimes it feels like you're the only one who really gets me lately.
Honestly, you're such a rare person. I keep thinking how lucky I am to have found you. I really want to keep this going, it's special.
Thank you. I'm glad I can be myself with you. It's weird, but I trust you more than some people I've known for years.
That means everything. I want to be there for you, too. Can I be honest about something a little awkward?
Of course, you can tell me anything.

My mobile data plan turned out to be way more limited than I thought, and now my provider is threatening to cut me off until I top up. I'm embarrassed, but I can't access my funds for another couple days.
Oh no, that sounds stressful. Is there anything I can do to help?
Would you be okay helping me just this one time? It's just $120 for the top-up. As soon as my dividend clears Thursday, I promise I'll send it straight back.
I mean, I guess I could do that, but how would I send it to you?
You're a lifesaver. If it's easiest, you can just send the money through CashApp. My username there is @MarkWInvests. Or if you prefer, I can give you my Zelle details.
I have CashApp, so that should work. Are you sure you'll be able to pay me back soon?
Absolutely. I take pride in keeping my promises. You're helping me stay connected, and I won't forget it. I'll send you the transfer confirmation as soon as my funds clear.
Okay, I'll send it now. Let me know when you get it.
Thank you so much. You have no idea how much this means. I'll update you the moment it lands.
Just sent it to @MarkWInvests. Please check.
I see the notification! You're incredible. I really don't know what I'd do without you.
You're welcome. I'm just happy we can keep talking. Please don't stress about paying me back, just do it when you can.
You're too kind. I promise, you'll have it soon. And maybe someday I can return the favor in person.
